title: normalized-event — forge-neutral event schema for AI-SDLC
description: Versioned JSON schema defining the canonical input to AI-SDLC dispatch logic. Entity kinds: work_item (issues), change_request (pull/merge requests), conversation (comments/discussions). Transitions: forge-neutral actions (labeled, opened, closed, synchronized, etc.). Actor fields: identity and type. Forge-neutral vocabulary maps vendor-specific concepts to common terms. Versioning: breaking changes increment major version (v1 → v2); non-breaking changes increment minor version (v1.1 → v1.2). See spec/normalized-event-versioning.md for detailed rules.

version.description: Schema version (semver). Breaking changes increment major version; non-breaking changes increment minor version; patch version for editorial corrections.

entity.description: The forge-neutral entity the event concerns.

kind.description: Entity type: work_item (issue/ticket), change_request (pull/merge request), conversation (comment/discussion thread).

id.description: Forge-specific entity ID (e.g., GitHub database ID, GitLab internal ID). Opaque string; not meant for display.

number.description: Forge-specific sequential number (e.g., GitHub issue #123). Null if forge lacks sequential numbering.

title.description: Short summary or title of the entity.

description.description: Detailed description or body of the entity (e.g., issue description, PR description, comment body).

state.description: Current lifecycle state. Forge-neutral values: open, closed, merged (for change_requests), archived. Adapter maps forge-specific states to this set.

labels.description: List of label names applied to the entity. Null if forge lacks labels.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when entity was last updated (ISO 8601).

transition.description: Forge-neutral action that triggered the event. Values: opened, closed, reopened, labeled, unlabeled, synchronized, assigned, unassigned, commented, etc. Adapter maps forge-specific actions to this set.

actor.description: The entity that caused the transition.

id.description: Forge-specific actor ID (e.g., GitHub user ID).

type.description: Actor kind: human user or automated bot.

login.description: Username or login (e.g., GitHub handle). Null if unavailable.

repository.description: Repository containing the entity. Null for cross-repository events (e.g., comments on a discussion).
